note: Dense NN (Normalization -> Dense64 -> Dense32 -> softmax) trained on Kaggle's atharvaingle/crop-recommendation-dataset. Test accuracy 0.9939 on a stratified 15% held-out split. Normalization is baked into the graph, so the app feeds raw (unnormalized) feature values directly. Dataset has no organic_carbon column, so this model uses 7 features, not the 8 in the original MODEL_SPECS.md draft.
